description: Scored drug-market and company safety briefs from openFDA: recalls (all and Class I), adverse event reports, label changes, and NDA/BLA and generic approvals for the US drug market, plus per-company recalls, adverse event reports, approvals and label changes for Pfizer, Eli Lilly and Johnson & Johnson, clinical-trial pipeline activity, and US drug shortages and discontinuations. Each brief is a 0-100 score with label, trend, drivers, risk flags, confidence and openFDA citations. POST /v1/brief {vertical, entity_id} returns one scored brief; POST /v1/overview returns every brief at once; POST /v1/verticals lists them. Verticals: drug-market (Are drug safety signals rising, and is the approval pipeline active?); company-safety (Are safety signals rising for this drug maker, and what has the FDA reported lately?); clinical-pipeline (Is this drug maker's trial pipeline growing or stalling?); drug-shortages (Are drug shortages and discontinuations rising in the US?). Raw scored series: /v1/signals, /v1/signal, /v1/explain, /v1/catalog, /v1/events. Every response is a single JSON object. Research signal, not investment advice.

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/verticals, POST /v1/brief, POST /v1/overview, POST /v1/signals, POST /v1/signal, POST /v1/explain, POST /v1/catalog, POST /v1/events; GET /v1/version, /v1/health. JSON body only. Bad input returns 400 + JSON.

serving.backend: Node.js HTTP server (zero npm dependencies) behind a RelayMiner at http://<container>:8080. No caller auth. Answers come from a private hub refreshed by a scheduled collector of official public data; 5-minute cache.
serving.notes: Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"].
